content: If you want to shine like a sun, first burn like a sun.
author: A. P. J. Abdul Kalam
explanation: Brilliance, leadership, and mastery require enduring the fiery crucible of hard work, discipline, sacrifice, and relentless self-refinement.
practicalInsight: When faced with fatigue or friction in your craft today, lean in with passion rather than looking for an easy exit.
reflectionPrompt: Am I expecting outward brilliance without being willing to endure the internal heat of deep preparation?
